7.3.2.4 LIN Status Acquisition
[SWS_Mirror_00034]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008, SRS_Mirror_00009
⌈The Bus Mirroring module shall evaluate the status reported by Mirror_Re-
portLinFrame. If it is LIN_TX_HEADER_ERROR, LIN_TX_ERROR, LIN_RX_ERROR,
or LIN_RX_NO_RESPONSE, the reported LIN source bus state shall be set to header
transmission error, transmission error, reception error, or no response.⌋
[SWS_Mirror_00035]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Mirror_00008, SRS_Mirror_00009
⌈The Bus Mirroring module shall poll the status of each active LIN source bus by cycli-
cally calling LinIf_GetTrcvMode from the Mirror_MainFunction. If the returned
TransceiverModePtr is LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL, the reported LIN source
bus state shall be set to online, otherwise to offline.⌋
caption: 7.3.2.4 LIN Status Acquisition

targets.why: Mapping LIN error status to Mirror status
